autoPrompt.title: Welcome — getting started guide
autoPrompt.description: A short path to create an account, import trades, read the dashboard, and open the journal.
autoPrompt.hint: You can always find this guide under Help, even if you dismiss this reminder.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.summary: Trading account, import, dashboard, and journal.

account.title: Create a trading account
account.body:
Open Trading accounts, then create an account (broker, currency, capital).
This is the foundation for linking trades and tracking PnL.
account.alt: Trading accounts page with the create-account form

import.title: Import or enter trades
import.body:
From Trades or the dashboard, import a CSV or enter a trade.
The format guide stays available in the import dialog.
import.alt: Trade import dialog with the format guide

dashboard.title: Read the dashboard
dashboard.body:
The dashboard summarizes your period: PnL, results, and activity.
Adjust the period and account filters as needed.

journal.title: Open the daily journal
journal.body:
The daily journal and day questions help you learn from each session.
Come back to Help whenever you want to resume this guide.

import-trades.title: Import trades
import-trades.summary: Load trades from a CSV instead of entering them one by one. Columns and checks before confirmation.

open-import.title: Open import
open-import.body:
Quickly import a trade history from a CSV file instead of typing every fill by hand.
From the Trades page, start Import. Pick the target account, then your CSV file.
open-import.alt: Import button on the Trades page

format.title: Check the format
format.body: Use the built-in format guide, fix columns if needed, then confirm the preview.
format.alt: CSV format guide in the import dialog

calendar.title: PnL calendar
calendar.summary: See PnL day by day to spot winning or losing streaks.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body:
Get a month-at-a-glance view of each day’s result and spot trends.
The calendar colors each day by PnL. Move between months to spot streaks.

day-detail.title: Day detail
day-detail.body: Click a day to see related trades and jump into the journal.

api-connections.title: API connections
api-connections.summary: Link a broker to sync trades automatically, without re-importing each time.

open-settings.title: Open API connections
open-settings.body:
Connect your broker (e.g. TopStepX) so trades can be pulled automatically with Sync.
Go to Settings → Trading, then scroll to the API connections block.
Today only TopStepX is available; more connections may be added later.
open-settings.alt: Settings Trading tab with the API connections block and TopStepX card

credentials.title: Enter your credentials
credentials.body:
Enter the username and API key from your broker (e.g. TopStepX: Settings → API on the platform).
The Documentation API link on the card opens the provider help. Never share your key.
credentials.alt: TopStepX card in API key edit mode

test-connection.title: Test the connection
test-connection.body:
Save, then use Test connection. The badge becomes Configured or Connected depending on the result.
Without a valid connection, trade sync stays unavailable.
test-connection.alt: TopStepX card with Connected badge and Save / Test buttons

sync-account.title: Sync an account
sync-account.body:
On the Trades page (or calendar), select a matching account type (e.g. TopStep), then use Sync once the integration is OK.
API sync can coexist with CSV import; it does not overwrite existing trades.
sync-account.alt: Trades page with a TopStep account and the Sync button

journal-questions.title: Journal questions
journal-questions.summary: Structure your trading review with reusable day and position questions.

flow.title: Understand the flow
flow.body:
Capture each session with fixed prompts (mindset, plan, trade grade…) instead of scattered free-form notes.
Three layers chain together:
1) Templates = reusable library.
2) Day questionnaire and Position questionnaire = ready-to-use question copies.
3) Answers = Questions page (day) and per-trade answers.
Open Settings → Questionnaire to see the three tabs.
flow.alt: Questions settings with Templates, Day questionnaire, and Position questionnaire tabs

templates.title: Create templates
templates.body:
In Question templates, create reusable prompts (yes/no, text, scale…).
Adding a template to a questionnaire creates an independent copy: editing the template does not overwrite questions already placed.

questionnaires.title: Fill the questionnaires
questionnaires.body:
Day questionnaire: once per trading day and account.
Position questionnaire: once per trade.
Add questions from templates (or create new ones) in each tab.

answer-daily.title: Answer every day
answer-daily.body:
Open Day questions (#journal-questions): pick the account and date, then answer.
Position answers show below the day form (or via compliance / trade detail). You can also reach them from the journal.
answer-daily.alt: Day questions page with the answers form

transactions-profitability.title: Transactions and profitability
transactions-profitability.summary: Track account cash (deposits/withdrawals) and real activity profitability (expenses, credits, taxes).

flow.title: Two pages under Management
flow.body:
Separate trading-account cash (Transactions) from your business ledger (Activity profitability: expenses, credits, tax).
In the Management menu you have two complementary entries:
1) Transactions = deposits and withdrawals on a trading account.
2) Activity profitability = business ledger (expenses, credits from withdrawals, tax payments).
Do not mix account cash movements with activity profitability.
flow.alt: Management menu open with Transactions and Activity profitability

transactions.title: Manage deposits and withdrawals
transactions.body:
Open Transactions: pick the account, then New Deposit or New Withdrawal.
History lists cash moves; account balance reflects them (with trade PnL).
transactions.alt: Transactions page with history and deposit / withdrawal buttons

profitability.title: View activity profitability
profitability.body:
Open Activity profitability: Balances by currency shows credits, expenses, and balance.
Debit / Credit / Tax and social payments tabs are for detailed entries.
profitability.alt: Activity profitability page with balances by currency

link-credits.title: Link withdrawals to credits
link-credits.body:
On the Credit tab, add a credit and link it to one or more Transactions withdrawals.
Cash leaving the account then feeds the activity ledger without confusing double entry.
link-credits.alt: Credit tab with a linked withdrawal

backtest-market-replay.title: Backtest journal and Market Replay
backtest-market-replay.summary: Log backtest observations and replay historical candles. A broker subscription (e.g. TopStepX) is required for market data.

flow.title: Two tools under Strategies
flow.body:
Backtest journal and Market Replay work together: the journal stores observations by campaign; replay plays the session so you can place manual trades.
Prerequisite: a broker API connection (Settings → Trading) and an active broker subscription to download historical candles.
flow.alt: Strategies menu with Backtest journal and Market Replay

backtest-journal.title: Open the backtest journal
backtest-journal.body:
In Backtest journal, pick a position strategy then a campaign (instrument + period).
Add observations (setup, entry, exit) to capture your manual tests.
backtest-journal.alt: Backtest journal page with a strategy and campaign

historical-data.title: Download historical data
historical-data.body:
Before replay, open Historical data to download candles (TopStepX).
Without a broker subscription and a configured API integration, no candles are available for Market Replay.
historical-data.alt: Historical data page to download candles

market-replay.title: Replay a session
market-replay.body:
Open Market Replay: pick the instrument and a session with data, press play, place entry / stop / target, then Send to journal.
The observation joins the linked campaign in the backtest journal.
market-replay.alt: Market Replay page with playback controls and position panel

position-strategies.title: Strategy management
position-strategies.summary: Define your position-taking rules (sections, checklist) and track their version history.

flow.title: Where to find it
flow.body:
Strategy Management (Strategies menu) is your trading playbook: sections, rules, active/draft/archived status.
These strategies also feed the backtest journal and dashboard filters.

list.title: Browse your strategies
list.body:
The page lists strategies with filters (active, drafts, archived) and search.
Use New strategy to create one, or View / Edit / Versions on a card.

edit-sections.title: Write sections and rules
edit-sections.body:
In the form, add sections (e.g. Setup, Entry, Invalidation) and checklist rules.
You can reorder sections and rules, then Save.
edit-sections.alt: Edit form with sections and rules

versions.title: Version history
versions.body:
Important saves can create a new version. Open Versions to compare, restore, or review history.
Keep your playbook evolution without overwriting the past.

trading-accounts.title: Trading accounts
trading-accounts.summary: Create, organize and switch between accounts to separate your trading environments.

list.title: Browse your accounts
list.body:
Trading accounts lists your environments (futures, prop firm, demo…).
Each account has its currency, capital and status.

create.title: Add an account
create.body:
Use New Account to set broker, currency and starting capital.
Trades, cash movements and API sync attach to that account.
create.alt: New Account button on Accounts page

switch.title: Switch active account
switch.body:
The dashboard account selector (filter bar) scopes the whole app.
Pick the right account before reviewing a period.
switch.alt: Account selector in the dashboard filter bar

display-settings.title: Display preferences
display-settings.summary: Language, timezone, theme and font so the journal matches your conventions.

open-display.title: Open Display
open-display.body:
In Settings, open the Display tab.
These choices apply across the UI (tables, charts, exports).

locale-timezone.title: Language and timezone
locale-timezone.body:
Choose UI language and the timezone for your user-facing dates.
Market timezones still apply when the domain requires them.

formats.title: Theme and font
formats.body:
Adjust theme, font size and typeface.
Date and number formats are also under Settings → Trading.
formats.alt: Theme, size and font in Display

trades.title: My trades
trades.summary: Browse, filter and open trade details for review and tagging.

list.title: Trades list
list.body:
My Trades shows the history for the selected account.
Scan contracts, side, PnL and dates.

filters.title: Filter the view
filters.body:
Narrow by dates, contract, profitability or position strategy.
Filters help isolate a series before analysis.

detail.title: Open a trade
detail.body:
Click a row for details (fills, notes, links).
Use it to correct or enrich an entry.

dashboard-filters.title: Dashboard in depth
dashboard-filters.summary: Period, account and KPIs so you can read performance without getting lost.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body:
The dashboard groups PnL, activity and period widgets.
Always check account and period first.

period-account.title: Period and account
period-account.body:
Use the filter bar to change period and account.
The view recomputes for that scope.

widgets.title: Read the indicators
widgets.body:
Total trades, win rate, curves: every widget follows active filters.
Cross-check with calendar or My Trades to dig deeper.

daily-journal.title: Daily journal
daily-journal.summary: Write and find session notes, separate from questionnaires.

open.title: Open the journal
open.body:
Journal groups entries by month.
Create a note to capture today’s session.

filters.title: Find an entry
filters.body:
Filter by account, dates or text search.
Useful for reviewing a streak or preparing a weekly recap.

entry.title: Write or edit
entry.body:
Open an entry to write in markdown, add context and save.
Come back later to refine with a cool head.
